title: MaterialDNA bounded dense-array validation work
objective: Close the demonstrated MaterialDNA capped-array scan-order gap so history/anomaly cardinality limits bound validation work for oversized plain-data tables, without broadening material architecture or depending on Studio.
acceptance: validateDenseArray returns false as soon as more than maxCount valid positive-integer keys have been observed instead of scanning the remaining oversized table
existing dense-array/hole/invalid-key behavior remains fail-closed and deterministic
history and anomaly caps remain 32 and canonical fixture identity/schema versions remain unchanged
add or preserve deterministic regressions for over-cap history/anomaly rejection without claiming a timing result that was not measured
notes: Capacity-mined from current main after confirming merged PR #50 intended strict MaterialDNA bounds to prevent pathological oversized payload cost. Current validateDenseArray checks entryCount > maxCount only after the pairs loop, so rejection is cardinality-bounded but scan work remains O(N) in supplied key count. Dependency avoids overlapping the active HG-BACKFILL-MATERIALDNA-COUNTERS exact-head salvage on the same production file.
